title: Turkish Smoky Lamb Kebabs
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring smoky lamb kebabs with a hint of spice. Perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, Turkish spice mix, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Thread the marinated lamb, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
6. Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with parsley.
